svg.title: Minor third versus major third (phone)
svg.desc: Minor third versus major third. A keyboard from C4 to C5 with C4 as the shared root and the upper notes E♭4 (m3, 3 semitones), E4 (M3, 4 semitones) each in its own identity colour. A table lists what stayed (root C4) and what changed (upper note, semitone count, and the Plogger shape, shadow and fill where they apply).

g.text: C4 to E♭4 (3) and C4 to E4 (4): one semitone
m3 → M3: +1 semitone on the upper note
